notes.title: Weekly POP:ONE Update!
notes.notes:
March 11, 2021 Change List

[b]Physics (PC VR only)[/b]

* PC VR: Fixed issue where climbing or other movement could become jittery
* PC VR: Fixed "random" movement speed fluctuation
* This is an entirely different physics system on PC VR, please let us know if there are any bugs

[b]Gameplay Balance[/b]

* Both Sodas: Healing amount doubled (from 25 -> 50)
* Both Sodas: Time to heal doubled
* Both Sodas: Max in inventory slot decreased from 5 -> 3
* AWP: Walk speed reduced to 80% max when AWP is in-hand
* Melee: Knife and sword movement bonus increased from 10% -> 15%

[b]Gameplay Fixes[/b]

* Guns: Automatic weapons now start firing again after being stuck through a wall while the trigger is down
* Waypoint Marker: Greatly increased ping distance and limited the loot ping distance
* Compass: Show cardinal directions instead of numbers
* Mutes: A mute will now cross mute (a muted player cannot hear the person that muted them)

[b]General[/b]

* Rewards: Impatient update ~ now "Continue" can be pressed to skip the reward/unlock animation
* Store: Fixed discount price not showing correctly
* Battle Menu: Fixed settings menu breaking if open while the match starts
* Post Match: Fixed UI displaying behind the environment
* Spectator: Setting height when in spectator mode no longer has a hole
* Localization: Assorted bugfixes

[b]Support[/b]

* For support visit http://support.bigboxvr.com to get access to self-help resources or file a ticket

[b]Known Issues[/b]

* PC VR: Cannot snap turn or smooth turn while in pods
* Steam VR users playing on an Oculus headset: When Purchasing Bureau Gold, you will need to take off your headset to approve the purchase
* If you see a notice that you need to "update to play" but don't see it in the store, uninstall and reinstall POP: ONE to force the upgrade to happen. You won't lose any progress or data.
​
\~ see you in game!

notes.title: Weekly Update for Dec 10th!
notes.notes:
[h1]Guns[/h1]
* DT11 & M1014: Shot pattern changed to be slightly wider
* DT11: Choke per level decreased from 10% -> 8% per level
* Inventory: Fixed issue where dropping a non-equipped gun lost the ammo

[h1]General[/h1]
* Matchmaking: Removed the 30 second match countdown and replaced with a dynamic waiting system for users on potato computers
* Desktop VR: Fixed climbing jitter when framerate is unstable
* Locomotion: Now uses center of head to determine height instead of headset when setting height
* Event: Fixed PC VR region issue that caused Event Tab to be missing
* Localization: Language switching is now instant and doesn't need a scene refresh
* Networking: Reduced bandwidth usage by 35%
* Misc performance improvements and bug fixes

[h1]Known Issues[/h1]
* Steam VR users playing on an Oculus headset: When Purchasing Bureau Gold, you will need to take off your headset to approve the purchase
* If you see a notice that you need to "update to play" but don't see it in the store, uninstall and reinstall POP: ONE to force the upgrade to happen. You won't lose any progress or data.

Can't wait to play these new changes with all of you \~ see you in game!

notes.title: Energy Core Event starts NOW - PATCH NOTES
notes.notes:
[u][b]Energy Core Scavenge Event is LIVE![/b][/u]
Collect the hidden Energy Cores to receive free in-game rewards, rewards are given at 5, 10 and 20 cores!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38755832/61850d3bb7d6fc023f527d2d816bbc28a50162d3.jpg[/img]


[u][b]PATCH NOTES[/b][/u]

[list]
[*] Oculus Headsets on Open VR: Fixed issue where you couldn't get past the set height screen

[*] Cosmos & Reverb G2: Proper headset and controller support

[*] HTC Vive: Fixed snap turn ejecting the gun's magazine and being unable to turn right.
[/list]

[b]General[/b]

[list]
[*] Post Match: Exit door icons show when a squadmate has left the match

[*] Servers: Improved latency detection to help ensure players get placed into servers with the lowest latency

[*] Reticle: Fixed issue where it would incorrectly show as yellow instead of red

[*] Comfort Vignette: Fixed mode labels to be "High", "Medium", "Low"

[*] Blood: Added ability to toggle OFF blood on the General Settings page

[*] Misc performance improvements and bug fixes
[/list]

[u][b]Known Issues[/b][/u]

[list]
[*] Steam VR users playing on an Oculus headset: When Purchasing Bureau Gold, you will need to take off your headset to approve the purchase

[*] If you're unable to find a match after 3-4 tries, force quit the app and relaunch to see if you need an upgrade
[/list]

If you're seeing a notice that you need to update to play and don't see it in the store, uninstall and reinstall POP: ONE to force the upgrade to happen. You won't lose any progress or data.
